LanguageData.Gun_MAT-49_762x25mm_RWP.label: MAT-49 7.62x25mm
LanguageData.Gun_MAT-49_762x25mm_RWP.description: The MAT-49 7.62x25mm is a compact submachine gun known for its robust design and reliability. Originally designed for close-quarters combat, it features a folding stock and a high rate of fire, making it effective in tight spaces. While its stopping power is moderate, its lightweight build allows for mobility and rapid response, making it a favored choice among colony defenders needing a balance of speed and efficiency in firefights.
